summary: Opened the RestoreCommittedLogs startup-recovery question in hashicorp/raft: recorded 12 sources, 6 behaviors/facts, 2 necessary gaps, and one source-grounded interpretation asserting that with Config.RestoreCommittedLogs enabled NewRaft advances lastApplied to the persisted commit index before the startup configuration scan (api.go:602-621, 723-754), so committed configuration entries at or below that index are never processed and the node keeps the snapshot's or an empty configuration - which decides election eligibility (raft.go:225-246), quorum size (raft.go:1085-1094) and leader commitment membership (commitment.go:35-64). Submitted one fixed experiment (draft/assurance_generated_test.go) that restarts real single-voter prefixes with the flag on and off, on a no-snapshot prefix and on a snapshot-plus-committed-config-change prefix, with six comparisons against controls. Retained receipt not yet part of the account; the multi-node stale-quorum consequence and the gap answers remain open.
